chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi attends a dinner with Lan Luozhi, a 100% pheromone-matched Omega, arranged by their families. Throughout the meal, Gu Suizhou bombards Shen with jealous text messages. After the meal, Shen declines to exchange contact info with Lan, citing his partner's jealousy. Gu Suizhou arrives at the scene, visibly agitated and acting possessive. Shen dismisses his friend Leapton and leaves with Gu Suizhou in his sports car.

new_characters.name: Lan Luozhi
new_characters.description: An Omega who is a 100% pheromone match for Shen Feizhi. She is independent, dislikes the Federation's forced matching system, and prefers 'obedient little puppies' as partners.

new_locations.name: Blue Star
new_locations.description: The planet where the story takes place, home to the Federation.

new_locations.name: Administrative District
new_locations.description: The area where Gu Suizhou works, located 30 minutes away from the restaurant.
